_README: Seeded once by the AI-Handbook sync and owned by this repository from then on: the sync never overwrites it. Complete it, set adopted to true, and run node scripts/map.mjs build. Setting enabled to false stands every guard and the forcing rule down at once (the back-out). Contract: docs/ai-context/agent-legible-codebase.md.
_programs: Every TypeScript program the indexed files belong to: each product tsconfig, plus supplementary programs for files no product tsconfig reaches (tests a tsconfig excludes, JavaScript tooling). A supplementary program takes roots (globs), and may extend a tsconfig to inherit its paths and options. The build refuses when an indexed file is reached by no program.
